name: TypeLabs
summary: MonkeyType-inspired typing test app with 160+ themes, sound effects and Spotify playback, built with React and shadcn/ui.
description: A customizable typing test app in the spirit of monkeytype: practice typing with 160+ built-in themes, custom fonts, keyboard shortcuts, sound effects and volume controls, and optional Spotify music playback through the Spotify Web API. Built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Query and shadcn/ui; a live demo runs at typelabs.vercel.app and the repository (MIT licensed) now lives at frstycodes/typelabs.
contains: keyboard shortcuts and custom font support
React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Zustand + shadcn/ui
